scope: Preserve fixed/absolute containing blocks during two-axis flex scroll and supported block flow. Block vertical flow uses existing pseudo offset; element-only block horizontal/diagonal flow uses opposite side margins, including supported block ::before/::after. Captured absolute containing blocks must be known for the new block path.
rootCause: Artificial transforms on ordinary wrappers introduce containing blocks. The prior flex-only correction left block horizontal/diagonal and absolute-plus-sticky layouts on that path. Internal stylesheet nodes from pseudo cloning must not be mistaken for flow boxes. External un-cloned absolute containing blocks have a different coordinate origin and retain the existing fallback.
implementation: Share opposite margin encoding; flex uses both axes without changing outer sizes/lines.
For block flow retain the existing non-collapsing synthetic/existing ::before vertical offset, apply horizontal margins to real flow boxes and supported before/after boxes.
Adjust positioned insets only when the source offsetParent is the source scroller. Preserve already-established inner and captured ancestor anchors.
Track registered source elements in a WeakSet. The block path keeps the existing fallback when an absolute containing block is not cloned; clear that WeakSet with clone source mappings/disposal.
No wrapping/reordering real children; source DOM and scroll remain unchanged.
method: The exact same final fixture/test file on each baseline; restore both clone-scroll.ts and task.ts in try/finally. Require all 165 cases and no unhandled/browser-session errors before accepting any baseline count. Incomplete intermediate browser runs are excluded.

candidate.skipReason: Inherited bounded WebKit native iframe GC control

sourceState: Every case first validates actual native-source setup and required nonzero scroll axes, then compares all 40x40 RGBA channels. Each capture asserts source DOM and scroll unchanged.

paintControl.layoutMarkers: Opaque backgrounds and hard-edged inset shadow; exact RGBA equality remains mandatory.
paintControl.reason: WebKit has a one-channel-unit difference for the unscrolled gradient in both the library and manually authored SVG foreignObject; native computed-style roundtrip is exact. This does not constitute a gradient byte-equality pass or a new correction.

history.note: Legacy 12/34-case counts and PNGs are historical and do not certify this final block scope.
